items.title: ESP32 accessory PWM MOSFET infrastructure: both SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR and SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR_FLYSKY sketches now include compile-time ACCESSORY_PWM_ENABLED flag (default 0 = off). When disabled the sketch uses the original digitalWrite ON/OFF path for LED, Laser, ACC, and Spare outputs so all relay hardware continues to work unchanged. When set to 1, all four outputs are driven by 8-bit LEDC PWM via MOSFET driver (5 kHz, ACCESSORY_PWM_FREQ_HZ / ACCESSORY_PWM_BITS constants); a bool-compat helper maps legacy app value 1 to full duty cycle (255) so existing ON/OFF app commands remain valid in PWM mode without any app-side change. The DB3000 variant validate_pins() self-test blink is also guarded by the same flag. Motion, fire, safety, PIR, buzzer, telemetry, and link-loss safe mode are completely unaffected. ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md was updated to document the PWM parameters and enable procedure.

Smart Sentry YOLO autotracking and loss-recovery fix (ISS-070, ISS-071, ISS-073): min_threat_score lowered from 0.5 to 0.25 so YOLO person detections reliably promote to engagement (ISS-070 Worked); fire_trigger_enter tolerances corrected from impossible sub-pixel values (0.08°/0.06°) to realistic YOLO-tracking values (2.5°/2.0°) and aim-lock tolerances widened to 3.0°/2.5° with required frames reduced from 7 to 2 so auto-fire can actually trigger (ISS-071 Worked); semantic_min_confirm_frames reduced from 2 to 1 to fix loss-recovery re-detection failure caused by ByteTrack track_id resets after each search pan, with loss_local_search spans widened to 20°/12°, dwell increased to 0.40s, and target_loss_timeout extended to 5.0s (ISS-073 Worked). app/config/smart_sentry_v3_0_0_settings.json and validate_settings.py updated.

Smart Sentry packaged OpenCV data fix: app/sentry_v2/face_identity.py now resolves the Haar cascade from valid packaged/runtime locations and falls back cleanly when the asset is absent instead of triggering repeated OpenCV file-open errors, while SmartSentryV2.spec and build_smart_sentry_v2_3_2_portable.ps1 now explicitly bundle cv2/data into the portable release so the promoted app includes haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml and related cascade assets.

Smart Sentry packaged YOLO runtime-prep fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now prepares frozen DLL search paths without the recursion-prone path-resolution step that could fail before torch imported, it keeps add_dll_directory handles alive for the process lifetime, and it now reports the exception type in YOLO runtime-prep failures so packaged import problems can be diagnosed directly from the runtime log. tools/repro_yolo_prepare.py was added to reproduce the frozen-runtime helper path outside the EXE before rebuilding releases.

Smart Sentry 1280x720 Windows camera fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now rejects black or partial startup frames during integer-camera probing and now prefers MSMF, then DEFAULT, then DSHOW on Windows. Direct validation with tools/camera_backend_probe.py and tools/camera_open_smoke_test.py showed DSHOW on this machine opened at 1280x720 but produced persistent partial frames while MSMF held a stable full-resolution feed, so the runtime now chooses the stable backend and keeps the camera open at the requested resolution without relying on the older crop-and-resize partial-frame workaround.

Smart Sentry camera startup stabilization: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now gives newly opened webcams a short post-open health grace window before blackout or partial-frame recovery can trigger, and it now rejects duplicate integer-camera open requests while a background webcam probe/reopen is already in progress. Together those guards keep the earlier blackout and partial-frame protections intact but stop transient startup artifacts and overlapping reopen attempts from forcing the source into an immediate close/reopen loop.

ESP32 WiFi+Debug Board USB firmware motion refinement: `arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino` keeps the existing UDP/app contract, rest action, sound action, and mode-2 topology unchanged, but now shapes pan/tilt output with a short synchronized motion plan, a fixed update cadence, and a small settle deadband so servo motion tracks app commands with less snap, less jitter, and smoother pan/tilt arrival under the same command payloads.

Smart Sentry keyboard-control safety update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py now persists a separate manual movement/fire keyboard-enable flag that defaults off, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now adds a dedicated Shortcut Keys checkbox for those risky controls, wires `W`, `A`, `S`, `D`, and hold-to-fire `Space` through the same manual movement and fire paths as the on-screen controls, keeps the existing manual arrow shortcuts behind the same gate, and releases keyboard fire if the app loses focus or the toggle is turned off. SMART_SENTRY_SHORTCUT_KEYS.md and SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md were synced to the new operator contract.

Smart Sentry v3.0.0 quick-access operator deck: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` now inserts a retractable quick-access panel between the live video canvas and the lower serial/status area, with pin-aware persistence, mirrored runtime toggles for sentry enable, video visibility, link, camera, and auto motion, a compact manual movement pad, and direct safety, fire, accessory, and control-source actions that reuse the existing Controls-tab handlers instead of introducing a second command path. `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py`, `SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md`, `SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md`, and `SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md` were updated to keep the new panel contract and persistence behavior aligned with the canonical settings file and current release-hold rules.

Smart Sentry v3.0.0 release-hold visibility refinement: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now hides release-held settings tabs from the active tab strip instead of rendering disabled placeholder pages, while keeping the original tab definitions in SETTINGS_TAB_SPECS so restoring a held tab only requires removing its entry from SETTINGS_TAB_RELEASE_HOLDS. SMART_SENTRY_RELEASE_HOLD_CONVENTION.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md, SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md, and SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md were synced to document the temporary hidden-state contract and quick restoration rule.

Smart Sentry v3.0.0 preview-and-hunt stabilization: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now keeps the live preview updating with a fallback presentation path when detector callbacks lag, records blackout-frame counts in runtime snapshots, and attempts camera recovery when a local webcam returns sustained near-black frames even if grabs still succeed. The same tab now resyncs engine pose when automatic moves are deferred so target-loss and PIR hunts cannot continue from an optimistic unsent position, while app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now spaces loss-recovery search steps more deliberately to reduce overshoot and keep hunt cadence closer to the real camera-and-servo update budget. SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md, SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md, and SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md were updated to preserve the new contract.

Smart Sentry firmware-source-of-truth correction: ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md, SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md, and PHASE_0_FILES_REQUIRED.md now pin the live app firmware path to arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino for the ESP32 WiFi plus Debug Board USB workflow and explicitly mark the Waveshare single-board bridge files as archived and on hold, not part of the current Smart Sentry app.

Smart Sentry v3.0.0 release-hold and packaging-prep update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now supports a documented release-hold convention that keeps unfinished tabs visible but disabled, with Facial Recognition and AI Assistant currently held for the v3.0.0 release while previous and next tab navigation skips them safely. run.py, app/smart_sentry_meta.py, smart_sentry_build_config.py, tools/validate_packaging_entrypoints.py, and build_smart_sentry_v2_3_2_portable.ps1 were also aligned so the active version resolves from SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_VERSION.txt first, and the new SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md plus SMART_SENTRY_RELEASE_HOLD_CONVENTION.md now document the active v3.0.0 release workflow.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 layout persistence refinement: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py` now persists standalone window geometry plus main/layout/bottom splitter sizes, `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` now restores those sizes through a unified startup path, ignores zero-size pre-layout splitter snapshots, and reruns the restore pass on first show so responsive panel state is captured only after the widget has a real layout, and `app/run_smart_sentry_v2_3_2.py` now restores and saves the frameless shell window position, size, and maximized state on close. The result is that the responsive settings panel, lower panes, and standalone window reopen where the operator left them instead of resetting each launch.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 hunting-behavior refinement: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py now carries a shared `Hunting` vs `Fast Reacquire` search-style preference plus explicit PIR `cue_hold_time_s`, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now leaves PIR cues after a short hold and runs a tighter zone-biased local hunt while after-target-loss recovery now performs a denser direction-aware local hunt with faster step cadence before wider expansion, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_pir_manager.py now starts PIR no-detect scans with local cue-area points before broader mirrored coverage, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py plus app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tooltips.py expose the new controls and wording. SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md, PIR_GUARD_QUICK_START.md, PIR_GUARD_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE.md, PIR_INTEGRATION_SUMMARY.md, PIR_AT_A_GLANCE.md, SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md, and SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md were synced to the same contract.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 identity-and-operator expansion: app/sentry_v2/face_identity.py now provides a lightweight Haar-cascade plus embedding-based known-face library that works without cv2.face, app/sentry_v2/target_filter.py now carries identity metadata on detections, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now replaces the placeholder Facial Recognition, Shortcut Keys, and AI Assistant pages with working runtime panels, adds a pinned Quick Keys button in the top strip, registers live window-focused keyboard shortcuts, lets operators register faces from imported images or the current live frame, labels recognized names on the preview, and can suppress friendly known faces from engagement. The same runtime now supports both robot buzzer cues and local human-like speech through Qt text-to-speech, including a Conversational Voice assistant mode with spoken replies, richer local operator commands, speech-style presets, a dedicated Voice Diagnostics panel, a `Validate Voices` check for every detected Qt voice, explicit tooltip coverage for the newer speech controls, and a guard that mutes the ESP32 buzzer while human voice mode is enabled. SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md, SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md, SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md, and the new SMART_SENTRY_SHORTCUT_KEYS.md were synced to the same contract.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 responsive UI refresh: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` now uses shared settings-panel metrics to scale the icon tab bar, previous and next tab buttons, manual movement matrix, preset-grid column count, key list heights, compact label widths, and several dense QBoxLayout control rows from the live right-panel size instead of relying on scattered fixed values, while the theme spacing was tightened to reduce panel bulk at the same footprint. Dense rows in Presets, Camera, Detection, and Prompted Targets can now flip vertical on narrower settings widths instead of only compressing. `app/run_smart_sentry_v2_3_2.py` now launches the standalone frameless shell at a softer 1280x860 default with a smaller minimum footprint. The settings panel can now compress more cleanly, the tab icon buttons follow panel width during splitter drags, and the overall operator layout stays more balanced across narrow and wide window sizes without changing Smart Sentry workflow or transport behavior.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 rest-execution refinement documented: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` now honors saved rest tilts below the normal guard minimum by clamping rest moves against the absolute sentry tilt limits instead of the generic guard/manual minimum path, so valid parked poses no longer snap back up during `Go Rest`. `SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md`, `SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md`, and `SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md` were updated to record the separate guard-vs-rest tilt contract and the guided home/rest move workflow.

Smart Sentry v2.3.2 PIR no-detect search visibility documented: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_pir_manager.py` and `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py` now treat the cue point as the center-confirmation step and, when scanning is enabled, begin the no-detect search from the first offset point instead of reissuing the already-visited center. `PIR_GUARD_QUICK_START.md`, `PIR_INTEGRATION_SUMMARY.md`, `PIR_AT_A_GLANCE.md`, `SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md`, and `SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md` now describe that visible offset-first search behavior.

Smart Sentry rest-position workflow implemented across app and firmware: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py` now persists a separate rest pan/tilt that defaults to the current home position, `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` adds Guard-tab rest controls plus startup and shutdown rest sequencing, `app/run_smart_sentry_v2_3_1.py` and `app/run_smart_sentry_v2_3_2.py` now defer window close to the tab’s graceful shutdown path, and `app/sentry_v2/sound_engine.py` keeps the new rest cue on the existing buzzer-tone system rather than adding a separate audio stack. The active WiFi firmware at `arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino` now accepts `rest` config, reports `rest_pan` / `rest_tilt`, and exposes `{"action":"rest"}` while continuing to use the existing `{"action":"sound"}` payload for buzzer playback.

Smart Sentry v2 adaptive after-target-loss recovery documented and locked in: `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py` now treats target loss as a context-aware branch instead of a single generic scan, choosing `rapid_handoff_search` when a stronger visible target is available and `persistent_reacquire_search` when the scene is sparse and no strong replacement is present. `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py` and `app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py` now expose the protocol-selection and tuning fields behind the `After Target Loss` controls, while `SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md`, `SMART_SENTRY_APP_CHANGE_IMPACT.md`, `SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_2_LIVE_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md`, and `SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md` now record this behavior as a protected app contract that must stay bounded, scene-aware, and return to guard cleanly when recovery expires.

Smart Sentry v2.3.1 environment and release workflow standardized: `build_smart_sentry_v2_3_1_portable.ps1` now defaults release output to `F:`, prefers Python 3.11 from `.venv311`, still supports explicit interpreter override through `SMART_SENTRY_PYTHON_EXE`, and validates against the active interpreter runtime DLL instead of a hard-coded Python 3.12 filename. `.vscode/settings.json` now pins the workspace interpreter to `.venv311`, the compilation protocol and packaging docs now treat `F:/SMART SENTRY V2.3.1` as the canonical release folder, and the docs now record the PyQt5 VC-runtime cleanup rule plus a future hardening checklist for build logs, interpreter reporting, release manifests, and smoke-test tracing.

Smart Sentry v2.3.1 portable YOLO release contract corrected: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now treats the release-root YOLO_MODELS folder as the public frozen-build drop location while still discovering bundled default models under SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_FILES/YOLO_MODELS, quick startup now schedules a later lazy YOLO auto-load instead of leaving YOLO fully manual, build_smart_sentry_v2_3_1_portable.ps1 now creates the public root-level YOLO_MODELS folder beside the packaged executable, and the compilation protocol, include list, manual, change-impact reference, and issue log were synced to the same release behavior. Optional ML support was also made truly lazy again so normal portable builds do not need to pull sklearn into PyInstaller analysis unless that runtime path is actually used.

Smart Sentry v2.3.1 runtime polish sync: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now keeps motion-led viewing smoother through preview-side presentation throttling, restores a readable command-status surface by suppressing automatic tracking-move churn while still surfacing manual actions and failures, flushes stale detector work immediately when detection modes change so the new mode takes effect faster, and adds timestamped Serial Output export plus open-folder actions for later AI analysis. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_detector.py keeps resize acceleration limited to pure motion-only modes, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_overlay.py removes the stale upper-left branding label, drops the forced 'moving' prefix, and now uses the operator-approved no-center-fill monochrome scope reticle, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py completes a finite target-loss pursuit plus scan sequence before returning fixed-guard mode cleanly to the configured home position. Threat AI saved-data and model-status messaging were also tightened through app/sentry_v2/ml_training_logger.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py.

Smart Sentry v2.3.1 WiFi baseline created: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino now replaces the older GPIO0-driven sweep behavior with an app-triggered UDP sweep action, keeps GPIO0 reserved strictly as the ESP32 BOOT strap, renames the DB3000 WiFi SSID to SMART-SENTRY-V2.3, and updates app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py plus app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py so the manual control tab exposes a dedicated Run Sweep button over the same queued transport path. ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, and SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_1_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md were synced for the new 2.3.1 release workflow.

Smart Sentry v2.3 DB3000 FlySky baseline added: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR_FLYSKY/SMART_SENTRY_V2_3_DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR_FLYSKY.ino now provides the documented DB3000 WiFi baseline with FS-iA6 i-Bus telemetry on GPIO21, a physical APP or RC mode switch on GPIO22, firmware-side app-vs-RC source arbitration with safe APP fallback when no receiver frames are present, and capability/runtime fields that drive the existing V2.3 control-source UI. ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_overlay.py were updated alongside the new sketch path, and the V2.3 UI now also removes the stale 'moving' target prefix and throttles main-thread video repainting to reduce navigation lag.

Waveshare single-board attempt closed and hybrid fallback activated: the later Step 9 state-machine retest did not produce confirmed visible servo movement, direct probing destabilized the motion-capable single-board path after initial command acceptance, and the user explicitly stopped further bench testing. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_FULL_TEST_SUMMARY_2026-04-05.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_HANDOFF_AND_USB_ACCESSORY_FALLBACK_2026-04-05.md, and SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now record that Step 7.6 was scheduler-only, Step 9 remained unstable with no confirmed motion, a `1000000` baud Step 9 build was compiled but not hardware-validated, and the active Smart Sentry runtime was switched to hybrid mode 2 so Debug Board USB handles pan and tilt while the Waveshare ESP32 remains on WiFi for IO and accessories.

Waveshare Step-gating correction documented: post-flash validation showed the Step 7.6 state-machine build was network-stable but not motion-capable because SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino still compiles servo writes and bus_ping bridging only at REINTRO_STEP 9 and above. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now explicitly marks Step 7.6 as a WiFi plus UART-scheduler validation build and adds the correct Step 9.6 compile override for the first motion-capable state-machine test.

Waveshare Step 7.6 UART state-machine path added: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now supports a compile-time REINTRO_UART_STATE_MACHINE_MODE override that replaces the old Step 7 single-byte receive path with a non-blocking UART transaction state machine using a 2 ms settle delay, a 15 ms bounded RX window, a 64-byte total cap, and a 16-byte per-loop chunk limit so servo UART response collection can be spread across multiple loop passes without continuous draining. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now documents this Step 7.6 variant, its exact compile override, and the first tuning reductions to try if WiFi or UDP regress.

Waveshare full test summary and app-path correction documented: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_FULL_TEST_SUMMARY_2026-04-05.md now records the full single-board Waveshare validation chain from the minimal isolation sketch through Step 8 B3, identifies Step 7 A3 as the highest stable firmware, records that Step 8 base, B2, and B3 all failed, and captures the live app integration finding that movement failures were caused by connection_type 4 dual-ESP32 WiFi mode targeting 192.168.4.2:9001 instead of the actual single-board bridge endpoint 192.168.4.1:9000. app/config/smart_sentry_v3_settings.json and app/app/config/sentry_v2_settings.json were corrected back to connection_type 3 for the active single-board WiFi bridge path.

Waveshare reintroduction B3 ring-buffer path added: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now supports a compile-time REINTRO_UART_RING_MODE override that stores UART bytes into a small ring buffer from the dedicated poll task and processes buffered bytes separately from the main WiFi and UDP loop. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now includes the exact B3 compile override that combines delayed UART init, task-based polling, and ring-buffered UART handling.

Waveshare reintroduction B2 task-mode path added: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now supports a compile-time REINTRO_UART_TASK_MODE override that moves Step 8 bounded UART polling into a dedicated FreeRTOS task with vTaskDelay(1), keeping the main loop free for WiFi and UDP servicing while preserving the existing delayed UART init path. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now includes the exact B2 compile override for this task-based UART polling variant.

Final Waveshare UART execution path staged: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now defaults to Step 6A, keeps UART init-only behavior gated away from any reads or writes until later stages, and supports compile-time overrides for UART RX pin, TX pin, baud, and init delay so Solution Path A variants can be tested without editing source again. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md now documents Solution Path A, Solution Path B, and the fallback architectures for when UART plus WiFi cannot be stabilized on the single-board bridge design.

Waveshare reintroduction sketch aligned to Step 5 and Step 6A execution: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now defaults to REINTRO_STEP 5, supports direct GPIO control with {"cmd":"set","pin":N,"value":0|1} for pins 4, 27, 25, and 26, and uses 250000 baud for the UART init-only stage on GPIO18 and GPIO19 without any UART reads or writes before Step 7. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md was updated to match the same Step 5 and Step 6A contract.

PlatformIO Step 1-4 validation passed: platformio/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_STEP_1_4_TEST built cleanly with PlatformIO, uploaded successfully to the Waveshare ESP32 on COM30, and passed runtime checks once the Windows SMART-SENTRY-V3 Wi-Fi profile was rebuilt for the new password 12345678. Serial showed the expected boot banner and stable [DIAG] logs, ARP resolved 192.168.4.1, ping returned 0 percent loss, station count reached 1, and UDP JSON test traffic replied with {"status":"ok","cmd":"test",...}.

PlatformIO Step 1-4 project added: platformio/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_STEP_1_4_TEST now contains a standalone Waveshare SoftAP plus UDP test project with structured packet handling, JSON parsing without actions, structured JSON replies, and GPIO initialization only. This mirrors the controlled reintroduction path through steps 1 to 4 while keeping UART, bus traffic, and GPIO toggling out of the runtime.

Controlled reintroduction path added: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST.ino now provides a compile-time REINTRO_STEP ladder that rebuilds the Waveshare bridge one feature at a time from the known-good UDP echo baseline, with explicit diagnostics for station count, heap, loop timing, UDP traffic, and UART activity. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BRIDGE_REINTRO_TEST_PLAN.md documents the strict flash-and-test order from raw UDP echo through JSON, GPIO, UART init, UART RX, and bus motion handling.

Waveshare WiFi isolation result: the minimal SoftAP plus UDP echo firmware at arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_WIFI_UDP_ECHO_TEST/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_WIFI_UDP_ECHO_TEST.ino was flashed successfully and passed the hardware-stack validation. Windows associated to SMART-SENTRY-V3, ARP resolved 192.168.4.1 to 44-1d-64-86-3a-7d, ping replied with 0 percent loss, UDP echoed payloads correctly on port 9000, and serial reported stations=1. This rules out a board-level SoftAP failure and shifts the root cause back to interaction inside the full bridge firmware path.

Waveshare WiFi stability retry: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino now runs bus UART work through a dedicated FreeRTOS task pinned to Core 0, adds explicit cooperative yielding in the main loop, simplifies SoftAP startup back to WiFi.mode(WIFI_AP) plus softAP() plus udp.begin(9000), and temporarily drops the Yahboom bus baud to 250000 in WIFI_STABILITY_TEST_MODE so SoftAP and UDP reachability can be revalidated under lower load. A new minimal hardware-isolation sketch was also added at arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_WIFI_UDP_ECHO_TEST/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_WIFI_UDP_ECHO_TEST.ino for direct SoftAP plus UDP echo testing.

Waveshare v3 handoff and fallback documentation added: SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_HANDOFF_AND_USB_ACCESSORY_FALLBACK_2026-04-05.md now records the full single-board WiFi bridge attempt, the firmware and network fixes tried, where flashing and source alignment succeeded, where SoftAP/IP/UDP servicing still failed, and the approved fallback plan to keep the Waveshare USB servo-driver path for motion while using the on-board ESP32 only for accessory outputs on the confirmed Pi-style header pins.

Smart Sentry v3 Waveshare switch-removal update: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino no longer configures or gates on the previous GPIO21 hardware arm switch, the bridge now reports switch_supported=false and relies on software safety for trigger blocking, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tooltips.py now present that switchless bridge state cleanly in the UI, and ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_APP_BRIDGE_COMPATIBILITY.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_PREP_REPORT_2026-04-05.md, and SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_BENCH_CHECKLIST.md were synced to the same contract.

Smart Sentry v3 Waveshare firmware-alignment update: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino now matches the vendor-confirmed bus path with GPIO18/GPIO19 at 1000000 baud, sends little-endian goal-position and move-time bytes, reports the real active-low hardware arm switch on GPIO21/header 40 in ack/state/cap packets, and keeps LED, laser, and trigger-servo outputs explicitly unassigned so the app only exposes confirmed hardware. arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_FULL_PIN_TEST/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_FULL_PIN_TEST.ino, ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_NANO_UPGRADE_SPEC.md, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md were synced to the same bridge contract, and a bench-prep report was added for tomorrow's flash and validation pass.

Smart Sentry v3 live FlySky override update: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino now turns the previously passive FS-iA6 i-Bus telemetry path into an active bridge control source, so CH1 and CH2 drive live pan and tilt override with a center deadband, CH3 drives the guarded MOSFET fire request path, CH4 and CH5 drive the accessory and spare relays, and CH6 selects local APP-vs-RC authority when the bridge is in auto mode. The bridge now blocks competing app motion/output writes while RC owns control, continues to honor the existing hardware switch and software safety chain, and reports RC signal validation from live decoded frames. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_FLYSKY_FSIA6_INTEGRATION.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_FLYSKY_FSIA6_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now reflect that live RC override is implemented in firmware while bench validation of the exact receiver wiring path remains a separate hardware step.

Smart Sentry v3 passive FlySky decode update: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino now includes a built-in passive i-Bus parser on header pin 10 / GPIO15 so the Waveshare bridge can publish live FS-iA6 channel telemetry and RC link health without depending on the outdated external IBusBM library timer path. SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_FLYSKY_FSIA6_INTEGRATION.md, SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_FLYSKY_FSIA6_VALIDATION_CHECKLIST.md, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now reflect that passive decode is implemented while live RC override and bench validation remain separate next steps.

Smart Sentry v3 Waveshare flash-readiness update: arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_WAVESHARE_UDP_BUS_BRIDGE.ino now uses an ArduinoJson 7-compatible trigger payload read so it compiles cleanly with the installed esp32:esp32 toolchain, tools/flash_esp32_udp.ps1 has been restored as the canonical local compile-and-upload helper, and ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now include the Waveshare v3 bridge sketch and direct flash workflow.

Smart Sentry v2 sound transport and volume update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now checks the actual ESP32 sound transport instead of treating a mode-2 Debug Board USB link as sufficient for buzzer playback, so sound no longer silently queues into a missing WiFi path. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now adds an always-visible pinned sound row in the Status panel with live transport state plus a persisted volume slider, and arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino now accepts volume_pct in the sound action payload and applies it as buzzer duty level after reflash.

Smart Sentry v2 procedural sound integration: app/sentry_v2/sound_engine.py now schedules non-blocking randomized buzzer cues for settings changes, new detections, tracking movement, aim lock, firing, PIR events, guard scanning, and target loss, while app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py adds a persistent Sound ON/OFF toggle and routes tone requests through the existing comm worker so UI responsiveness and transport abstraction are preserved. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now supports SOUND transport over serial and a dedicated UDP sound action for ESP32-backed modes, and the canonical arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino firmware now drives a passive buzzer on GPIO4 with non-blocking timed tone playback.

Firmware documentation sync: ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md, ESP32_UDP_FLASH.md, CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md, PHASE_0_FILES_REQUIRED.md, ESP32_PIN_QUICK_REFERENCE.md, and ESP32_WIFI_UART_DEBUGBOARD_MIGRATION_SUMMARY.md now treat arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR/SMART_SENTRY_V2_0_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino as the canonical Smart Sentry WiFi baseline, correct the WiFi defaults to 192.168.4.1:9000 / SSID DB3000-ESP32, document GPIO2 status LED support and runtime PIR-trigger blink control, and note that the newer sketch still prints the legacy DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR boot banner.

Smart Sentry v2 trigger-runtime and tracking-profile correction: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now pushes projectile trigger-servo runtime tuning through the comm layer for any live transport instead of treating it as WiFi-only, applies those trigger-servo fields when engagement or master presets are loaded, refreshes the trigger travel summary, surfaces an explicit warning if the connect-time initial movement send fails, and keeps move-failure logs tied to movement errors rather than stale trigger-config labels. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now clears stale error state after successful movement and trigger-runtime sends, while the active canonical and mirrored Sentry v2 settings files have been relaxed away from the overly restrictive person-only sniper profile so YOLO tracking can qualify targets again under normal live use. CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now documents both the transport-authority rule for trigger runtime sync and the risk of misdiagnosing motion failures from saved-profile over-tightening or stale command labels.

Smart Sentry v2 manual-control and diagnostics update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now rearranges the Manual Movement panel into a centered fixed-size control matrix, adds one-tap Min/Max Pan and Min/Max Tilt jump buttons plus corner presets that reuse the same clamped absolute-move path as Home/Move to Guard, adds diagonal step buttons with distinct arrow styling, adds an Export Runtime Snapshot action that writes timestamped JSON plus Markdown summaries under the repo snapshots folder using live config, engine, comm, camera, YOLO, and file-reference state, and converts the Engage tab's crowded aim-lock and center-fire preset button strips into compact combo-plus-apply controls so long labels no longer clip inside tight rows. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tooltips.py now documents the expanded movement presets, snapshot export, and preset selectors, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md records both the manual-control matrix coupling and the requirement for snapshot export to stay sourced from live runtime objects rather than duplicate caches.

Smart Sentry v2 UI review fixes: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now uses a compact settings-tab container that reports height from the visible scroll page instead of hidden advanced tabs, preventing the standalone window from inflating vertically at startup, and it now wires tooltip coverage into previously undocumented Prompted Targets, no-fire masks, scope-view, PIR lockout, custom master-profile, and guard-overlay controls. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tooltips.py now includes the missing expert-control and preset tooltip text, and CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md documents both the compact-tab height coupling and the requirement to keep tooltip metadata aligned with live controls and preset keys.

Smart Sentry v2 live-video latency trim: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now avoids several redundant full-frame copies on the own-camera path, keeps the cached display frame by reference instead of cloning it again, and requests shallow capture buffering for live OpenCV sources where the backend supports it. This reduces UI-side video sluggishness and lowers end-to-end display latency without changing detector behavior or engagement logic.

Smart Sentry v2 precision pose-sync fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now records when pan/tilt commands were issued and how long the commanded move is expected to take, then refuses to overwrite engine.current_pan/current_tilt with fresh-but-delayed Debug Board servo feedback until that move has had time to settle or the measured pose is already close to the commanded target. This prevents the precision aiming loop from re-basing itself onto stale in-flight readback and repeatedly chasing the wrong angle during live tracking and fire micro-adjustment.

Smart Sentry v2 settings-path and motion-gate correction: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_detector.py now makes the existing motion_gate_threshold materially gate the hybrid FrameDiff+YOLO and BackSub+YOLO detector paths before YOLO is trusted, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now keeps the legacy nested settings file synchronized with the canonical app/config/sentry_v2_settings.json runtime file during load and save so standalone tuning cannot silently drift between two conflicting Sentry v2 settings copies. CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now documents both couplings so future preset/startup edits keep detector behavior and settings persistence aligned.

Smart Sentry v2 move-dispatch priority fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now uses a small coalescing move queue instead of a single pending move slot, gives manual arrows/Home/Move to Guard a short priority window over engine-generated tracking slews, and prevents automatic tracking updates from overwriting an already-queued manual recovery move before it reaches the Debug Board. This addresses a shared-runtime path where manual controls could appear dead and tracking motion could be collapsed away under live detector/engine activity even though the background comm worker and COM34 transport were still running.

Smart Sentry v2 top-of-panel hardware monitor: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now pins a live hardware-monitor block at the top of the Status group showing safety/fire-path state, Debug Board servo feedback health, bus-servo voltage, load/torque proxy, and ESP32 current telemetry when available. app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now parses periodic ESP32 WiFi state packets for safety/current-fault/current values and supplements servo position feedback with conservative voltage/load register reads from the Yahboom bus servos. The active arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino source now includes pan/tilt/total current values in its periodic state packet so the UI can show real mA telemetry after the firmware is reflashed.

Smart Sentry v2 pan-axis resend safeguard: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py no longer suppresses repeated pan/tilt writes from the Debug Board movement path unless there is fresh live servo feedback proving the last commanded pose is real, and it now clears the remembered bus-servo command cache after a write failure. This prevents a stale 'already sent' cache entry from leaving a non-responding pan axis stuck while the UI and engine continue issuing movement commands in open-loop mode.

Smart Sentry v2 servo-protocol documentation and validation update: CHANGE_IMPACT_REFERENCE.md now records that Yahboom debug-board reply packets may use an FF F5 header and that live validation is required before changing feedback parsing again, while test_bus_servo_read.py has been cleaned up into a reusable validation utility that accepts both FF FF and FF F5 reply headers and can verify readback from explicit servo IDs and named registers on live hardware.

Smart Sentry v2 servo-feedback protocol fix: vendor-captured YB-SD35M replies from the Yahboom debug board were observed to use an FF F5 reply header rather than FF FF, so app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now accepts both reply forms for ping and register-read parsing and tools/yahboom_servo_debugger.py mirrors that same compatibility. This removes the false 'Waiting for first servo feedback reply' state when the servos are actually answering through the debug board.

Local Yahboom servo debug replacement added: tools/yahboom_servo_debugger.py provides a resizable Windows-friendly fallback utility for the YB-SD35M debug board with raw TX/RX logging, port open/close, ping, position read, position write, and ID write support so servo diagnostics no longer depend on the vendor Servo debugging platform v2.1 window layout bug.

Smart Sentry v2 Debug Board bus-IO contention fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now serializes bus-servo ping/readback traffic with pan/tilt write packets on the shared Debug Board COM link, backs feedback polling off more aggressively after movement or repeated no-reply readback attempts, and avoids resending unchanged axis packets on every bus-servo move. This reduces mode-2 Write timeout stalls and cuts unnecessary Debug Board traffic on marginal pan/tilt links while the first servo-feedback reply is still unavailable.

Smart Sentry v2 projectile-trigger runtime tuning update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now exposes saved projectile trigger-servo rest angle, fire angle, and travel speed controls, pushes those values to the mode-2 ESP32 over WiFi at connect-time and on change, adds a saved PIR-event LED blink toggle, moves the Connection panel's Connect button above the Connection Mode section, and refreshes the WiFi pinout dialog to show GPIO2 status-mirror wiring and the current WiFi-plus-Debug-USB transport split. The active arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino firmware now applies those trigger-servo settings at runtime and can suppress PIR-driven LED blinking when requested.

ESP32 mode-2 firmware debug-indicator update: arduino/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR/DB3000_ESP32_UDP_PIR.ino now drives GPIO2 as the explicit status blink output so an external LED can mirror incoming command activity even when the onboard ESP32 LED is hidden inside the turret base.

Smart Sentry v2 first servo-feedback slice: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now performs conservative background Debug Board bus-servo position polling for pan and tilt, normalizes that readback into Smart Sentry's logical angle frame, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now shows live commanded-versus-measured angle status while also feeding fresh measured pose back into the engine before each frame update. This adds a production readback path for verifying real servo response and lets live tracking plan from measured turret pose without yet introducing a deeper closed-loop controller.

Smart Sentry v2 recovery-status readout: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now exposes the engine's current loss-recovery phase and most recent reacquire note in the pinned Status panel, so pursuit/local-search/expanding-scan behavior is visible at runtime without relying only on overlay text or serial logs.

Smart Sentry v2 Home reset + tilt-control correction: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now maps the manual tilt arrows to the physical direction the current hardware expects, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now treats Home/Move to Guard as a full runtime reset that clears active target memory, loss-recovery anchors, return timers, PIR cue state, and patrol anchors before re-basing guard position to the selected home angles. This prevents Home from slewing correctly once and then snapping back toward stale pre-Home engagement memory.

Smart Sentry v2 manual-movement recovery fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now treats the Pan/Tilt Motion toggle as an automatic-motion gate only, so manual arrows, Home, and Move to Guard still queue Debug Board pan/tilt commands even when automatic tracking or PIR-driven slews are disabled. This removes a silent all-movement lockout path that could make standalone mode appear frozen after motion-control changes.

Smart Sentry v2 mode-2 movement transport correction: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now falls back to the earlier working Debug Board checksum default (`sub`) when servo probing is inconclusive, and mode-2 movement updates once again refresh the IO-side safety/mode state on successful pan/tilt moves without requiring WiFi success for movement itself. This narrows a post-regression path where standalone mode could connect and change sentry states but still fail to move pan/tilt hardware.

Smart Sentry v2 motion-filter hardening: app/sentry_v2/target_filter.py now applies size gates to non-prompted motion/foreground detections instead of letting them bypass core sizing rules, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_detector.py tightens frame-diff and background-subtraction contour extraction to reject small, thin, and edge-dominant junk blobs, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py makes the motion-centric detection presets and active settings files substantially stricter, and Home/Move to Guard now clears active engagement and PIR-cue state through app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py so manual guard holds are not immediately overridden by stale sentry state.

Smart Sentry v2 motion-profile correction: the active Sentry v2 settings files now use a strict generic motion filter again instead of a dog-only semantic filter inside motion-locked mode, restoring movement on credible moving-object detections while keeping the tighter contour and size gating that reduced false positives.

Smart Sentry v2 mode-2 runtime config correction: the canonical standalone settings file now points the Debug Board movement link back to COM28 and clears the unused ESP32 USB port field for WiFi+Debug mode, matching the repo's validated servo diagnostic path so manual arrows and Home commands reach the bus-servo transport used for pan/tilt movement.

Smart Sentry v2 serial-port portability fix: connect-time COM selection in app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now prefers the user's typed port over stale scan-dropdown values, auto-resolves live serial ports when saved Debug Board or ESP32 COM numbers have changed, and updates startup auto-connect to wait for or adopt the currently enumerated Debug Board port instead of failing on an outdated saved COM assignment.

Smart Sentry v2 serial diagnostics update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now reports busy COM ports as an explicit 'already in use by another process' error so movement failures caused by a locked Debug Board port are visible immediately in standalone mode instead of appearing as an opaque open-port failure.

Smart Sentry v2 camera runtime recovery update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now tolerates longer bursts of camera grab failures and attempts an automatic reopen of the last local camera source before declaring the source closed, reducing false camera shutdowns caused by brief OpenCV/backend stalls during live operation.
Smart Sentry v2 pinned control header refinement
items.description: Moved the top Enable Smart Sentry and Show Video Feed controls into a dedicated pinned header above the tab widget so those controls stay fixed while individual settings pages scroll. This keeps the right panel chrome stable and improves standalone usability on narrower layouts.

items.title: Smart Sentry v2 finite loss-recovery update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now runs a bounded four-stage recovery path after target loss using forward pursuit, local scan, expanding scan rings, then normal queue advance or return at timeout; app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py and the active Sentry v2 settings files now include explicit loss_recovery_enabled and expanding-search knobs so this behavior no longer depends on continuous_hunt_on_loss being enabled.

Smart Sentry v2 cleanup: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now gives the right-side scroll area an explicit solid background so resized or repainted settings panels do not visually bleed through to lower layers, and app/run_sentry_v2.py now treats torch preload as a silent best-effort optimization instead of printing a non-fatal boot warning when standalone UI startup falls back to lazy ML loading.

Smart Sentry v2 quick-start update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py now persists a quick_startup_enabled flag, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now skips launch-time auto camera open, auto-connect, and YOLO auto-load when that flag is enabled so the standalone window appears faster, and the active app/config/sentry_v2_settings.json now enables that fast-launch path by default.

Smart Sentry v2 right-panel usability update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now keeps Status in a compact pinned bottom section with a visual separator, removes the bottom panel-width slider, converts the Connection tab's URL/playback/maintenance rows away from overflow-prone single-line layouts, restores normal splitter dragging for the right pane, opens that pane at a larger one-time default width (620px), forces the inner scroll-area settings widget to match the visible viewport width, marks each settings-tab page as horizontally ignorable so oversized hidden page hints no longer pressure the splitter, and compacts the widest combo boxes and Engage captions so controls stop claiming unnecessary width. app/run_sentry_v2.py now opens the standalone top-level window wide enough to match that default right-pane width.

Smart Sentry v2 mode-2 transport fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now uses movement-only startup commands for Debug Board pan/tilt in WiFi+Debug mode, surfaces degraded movement-only connections when ESP32 WiFi IO is unavailable, and labels projectile trigger mode consistently as the ESP32 GPIO13 servo path; the active Sentry v2 settings files were also updated to use projectile trigger mode for the current setup.

Smart Sentry v2 PIR + motion-control update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_pir_manager.py now suppresses near-simultaneous cross-sensor PIR overlaps with an adjustable lockout and caps effective PIR scan width to stay inside enabled sector spacing, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py adds an Apply 120° PIR Layout action plus a Pan/Tilt Motion toggle that stops servo movement without disconnecting the Debug Board, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now honors that runtime movement-disable state while leaving serial/PIR detection flow active.

Smart Sentry v2 PIR priority fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now queues PIR events during live ENGAGING tracking instead of letting them immediately hijack a camera-confirmed target, while still allowing PIR cues to interrupt RETURNING or idle behavior; this keeps blind-spot sensing active without causing abrupt cue jumps during an ongoing visual lock.

Smart Sentry v2 tracking stabilization: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now limits prediction to stable semantic targets, clamps heading-derived lead so track jitter cannot turn into large chase jumps, and only activates staged loss pursuit/local search when the existing continuous-hunt-on-loss behavior is enabled; this keeps PIR cue/search logic and non-hunt presets aligned with prior movement behavior.

Smart Sentry v2 tracking upgrade: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now applies predictive motion lead during precision aim and fire micro-adjust, continues briefly in the last seen direction when a target drops out, and scans locally around the loss point before returning; app/sentry_v2/simple_tracker.py also relaxes class-strict matching when boxes remain strongly aligned so target history survives short detector label flips.

Smart Sentry v2 runtime hardening: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py, app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py, and app/sentry_v2/threat_scorer.py now surface previously silent PIR callback, cleanup, precision-logging, and optional-ML failures through runtime diagnostics instead of swallowing them silently, improving standalone compile-readiness and packaging smoke-test visibility without changing normal control flow.

Smart Sentry v2 trigger-settings persistence + connection-status wording update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now saves auto-trigger and trigger-mode changes to the canonical Sentry v2 settings file immediately when those controls change, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_comm.py now reports Debug Board status as servo probe inconclusive when the quick ping heuristic does not positively identify a checksum mode, avoiding false no-servo-response warnings on otherwise working hardware.

Smart Sentry v2 PIR behavior fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_engine.py now immediately starts PIR cue pursuit on incoming PIR events whenever sentry is active, including while ENGAGING or RETURNING, by safely preempting stale engagement or return state and slewing to the triggered sensor's configured cue angle.

Smart Sentry v2 PIR diagnostics fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now surfaces connect-time PIR-enable command failures through the existing command result channel instead of silently ignoring send_pir_enabled errors, making no-movement PIR setups immediately visible in the runtime log when the ESP32 PIR link is unavailable.

Smart Sentry v2 startup connection regression fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py no longer mutates the configured Debug Board COM port while checking startup port availability for mode 2 auto-connect, preventing silent port switching when multiple serial devices are present; startup retries now preserve the saved debug-port selection instead of overwriting it from the scan list.
